newsitem.title: USA: American Gen to post Q2 charge from sale.
newsitem.headline: American Gen to post Q2 charge from sale.

text.p: American General Corp said on Friday that it will post an after-tax charge of $26 million in the second quarter from the sale of the company's bank credit card portfolio to GE Capital Services, a unit of General Electric Co.
The credit card loans had an aggregate book value of $499 million as of May 31.

American General said the deal is part of the plan it announced in February to sell non-strategic assets consisting of its satellite dish loans and bank credit card loans. The company sold its satellite dish loan portfolio earlier this month.
In last year's second quarter, American General reported revenues and deposits of $2.7 billion and net income of $168 million, or $0.79 a share.
